title: अनुसन्धानात्मक लेखन र भाषाशिक्षणका बिच सम्बन्ध
nepali: स्तरीय लेखाइ सिपको विकास गर्ने उद्देश्यले भाषाशिक्षणमा विभिन्न खालका लेखाइका अभ्यास गरिन्छ । उक्त लेखाइ सिपका गतिविधिहरूमध्ये अनुसन्धानात्मक लेखाइलाई लेखाइ सिपको उत्तरवर्ती चरणको क्रियाकलापका रूपमा लिइएको छ । यस लेखमा अनुसन्धानात्मक लेखन र भाषाशिक्षण बिचको सम्बन्धलाई मुख्य विषय बनाइएको छ । अनुसन्धानको पाराडाइम वा दर्शनअन्तर्गत व्याख्यानवाद नमुना वा आयाम (क्ष्लतभचउचभतष्खष्कm उबचबमष्नmक) मा आधारित यस लेखमा अनुसन्धानको गुणात्मक पद्धतिलाई अपनाइएको छ । गुणात्मक पद्धतिअन्तर्गत वर्णनात्मक र विश्लेषणात्मक ढाँचाको केन्द्रमा रहेर द्वितीयक सामग्रीका लिखित दस्तावेजका स्रोतबाट सामग्री सङ्कलन गरी विश्लेषणात्मक विधिका आधारमा सङ्कलित सामग्रीको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । अनुसन्धानात्मक लेखन र भाषाशिक्षणका बिचको सम्बन्ध देखाउन अनुसन्धानको परिचय, अनुसन्धानात्मक लेखनको प्रकृति, विशेषता, यसका अन्तर्कथ्य, ढाँचा, भाषाका सिपमध्ये लेखाइ सिपको उत्तरवर्ती चरणको क्रियाकलापका रूपमा प्रस्तुत गरी भाषाशिक्षणसँग अनुसन्धानको सम्बन्ध तथा भाषाको कक्षामा अनुसन्धानको भूमिकालाई विशिष्टीकृत र व्याख्यात्मक शैलीमा प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ । यस लेखमा विश्वविद्यालय तहका विद्यार्थी तथा विज्ञद्वारा लेखिएको लेखनका रूपमा अभ्यास गरिएको अनुसन्धानात्मक लेखनलाई मानक, स्तरीय, विश्वसनीय तथा वैध र वस्तुपरक लेखनका रूपमा प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ । विशुद्ध अनुसन्धानात्मक लेखनभित्र पनि लेखनमा एकरूपता, ढाँचाबद्धता, चुस्तता र व्यवस्थितता जस्ता गुणका आधारमा मात्र यस लेखलाई परिसीमित गरिएको छ । साथै परीक्षाको उत्तर लेखनमा पनि अनुसन्धानात्मक नमुनाका सेटिङ, किनारा छोडाइ, शब्द तथा अनुच्छेद संरचना आदिमा स्तरीय र व्यवस्थित लेखन अभ्यासको विकासका लागि भाषाशिक्षणमा अनुसन्धानात्मक लेखनको अभ्यास निरन्तर गरिरहनुपर्छ भन्ने मान्यता राखिएको छ । भाषाशिक्षणलाई नै स्तरीय सिकाइ उपलब्धिका रूपमा विकास गर्न अनुसन्धानात्मक संरचनाका लिखित अभिव्यक्तिको अभ्यास गरिरहनुपर्छ भन्ने निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ । साथमा भाषाशिक्षणका सन्दर्भमा अनुसन्धानात्मक लेखनलाई स्तरीय तथा वैज्ञानिक लेखन सिपका रूपमा अभ्यास गरिने भएकाले यस लेखको उपयोगिता रहेको छ ।
american_english: With the objective of developing standard writing skills, various types of writing exercises are conducted in language teaching. Among these writing skill activities, research writing is regarded as an advanced-stage activity in writing skills. In this article, the relationship between research writing and language teaching is made the central subject. Based on the interpretivist paradigm or dimension under research paradigms or philosophy, this article adopts a qualitative research methodology. Focusing on descriptive and analytical frameworks within the qualitative method, materials were gathered from written documentary sources of secondary materials, and the collected materials were analyzed on the basis of analytical methods. To demonstrate the relationship between research writing and language teaching, by presenting the introduction to research, the nature of research writing, its characteristics, thematic content, structure, and framing it as an advanced-stage activity among writing skills in language, the connection of research with language teaching and the role of research in the language classroom are presented in a specialized and expository style. In this article, research writing practiced as writing produced by university-level students and experts is presented as standard, quality, reliable, valid, and objective writing. Even within pure research writing, this article is delimited solely on the basis of qualities such as uniformity, structural conformity, conciseness, and systematic organization in writing. In addition, the view is held that to develop standard and systematic writing practices in examination answer writing—regarding research-style page layout, margins, vocabulary, and paragraph structure—the practice of research writing must be carried out continuously in language teaching. It is concluded that in order to cultivate language teaching itself as a quality learning achievement, written expression following research structures must be practiced continuously. Furthermore, because research writing is practiced as a standard and scientific writing skill within the context of language teaching, this article holds distinct practical utility.
british_english: With the aim of developing quality writing skills, diverse types of writing exercises are undertaken in language teaching. Among these writing skill activities, research writing is taken as an advanced-stage activity of writing skills. In this paper, the relationship between research writing and language pedagogy forms the principal focus. Grounded in the interpretivist paradigm or dimension within research philosophy, this paper adopts a qualitative research methodology. Centring on descriptive and analytical frameworks within the qualitative methodology, material was gathered from written documentary sources of secondary data, and the gathered material was analysed using analytical methods. To demonstrate the link between research writing and language teaching, by setting out an introduction to research, the nature of research writing, its characteristics, inner thematic content, structure, and treating it as a higher-level activity among language writing skills, the connection between research and language teaching as well as the role of research in the language classroom are presented in a specialised and expository manner. In this paper, research writing practiced as compositions produced by university-level students and specialists is presented as standard, high-quality, dependable, valid, and objective writing. Even within pure research writing, this paper is confined solely to qualities such as consistency, structured formulation, conciseness, and systematic organisation in writing. Moreover, the view is maintained that in order to foster high-standard and systematic writing practice in examination answer writing—concerning research-model layout, margin spacing, word choice, and paragraph structure—the practice of research writing must be continuously sustained in language teaching. It is concluded that so as to develop language teaching itself into a quality learning outcome, written expression following research structures must be regularly practised. In addition, since research writing is exercised as a standard and scientific writing skill in the context of language teaching, this paper offers genuine utility.
australian_english: With the goal of developing quality writing skills, various types of writing exercises are carried out in language teaching. Among these writing skill activities, research writing is treated as an advanced-stage activity in writing proficiency. In this paper, the link between research writing and language teaching is made the primary focus. Grounded in the interpretivist paradigm or dimension under research philosophy, this article adopts a qualitative research approach. Focusing on descriptive and analytical frameworks within the qualitative approach, material was collected from written documentary sources of secondary materials, and the collected material was analysed using analytical methods. To show the relationship between research writing and language teaching, by presenting an introduction to research, the nature of research writing, its traits, core content, structure, and framing it as an advanced-stage activity among language writing skills, the link between research and language teaching along with the role of research in the language classroom is presented in a specialized, explanatory style. In this paper, research writing practiced as work produced by university students and experts is presented as standard, quality, reliable, valid, and objective writing. Even within pure research writing, this paper is strictly limited to qualities such as consistency, structural order, crispness, and systematic organisation in writing. Additionally, the view is put forward that to foster quality and organised writing habits in exam answers—covering research-format layout, margins, phrasing, and paragraph structure—research writing practice must be kept up continuously in language teaching. The conclusion is drawn that to turn language teaching itself into a quality learning outcome, practicing written expression with research structures needs to continue. As well, since research writing is practiced as a standard, scientific writing skill in language teaching contexts, this article offers clear practical value.
informal_english: To help students get their writing up to scratch, language classes make use of all sorts of writing exercises. Out of all those writing activities, research writing is seen as a proper advanced step in mastering writing skills. This paper zeroes in on the connection between doing research writing and actually teaching a language. Working within an interpretivist paradigm under research philosophy, the paper goes down the qualitative research route. Sticking to descriptive and analytical setups within that qualitative approach, bits and pieces were pulled from written secondary documents, and everything gathered was analysed using analytical methods. To show how research writing and language teaching tie together, the paper walks through what research is, what research writing looks like, its key traits, what goes into it, its layout, and frames it as a top-tier activity among language skills, laying out the link with language teaching and its spot in the classroom in a really detailed, explanatory way. In this piece, research writing done by uni students and experts is held up as proper standard, high-quality, solid, valid, and objective work. Even inside pure research writing, the paper keeps things strictly focused on stuff like consistency, clear structure, tightness, and keeping writing tidy. What's more, it argues that to build up decent, structured writing habits for exam answers—like sorting out margins, page layouts, vocabulary, and paragraphs—you've got to keep practising research writing in language teaching all the time. The takeaway is that if you want language teaching to lead to proper quality learning outcomes, students have to keep practising writing that follows research formats. Plus, since research writing gets used as a solid, scientific writing skill in language classes, this paper actually comes in pretty handy.
